platform_label: AWS c7i.8xlarge (Intel(R) Xeon(R) Platinum 8488C, 32 logical CPUs, Linux)
caveats: Headless paced runs: in-process TX generators, no transport, RX delivered to the engine's RX history; client and transport costs are not included.
Page latency = delivery - release (inputs are always complete in-process).
L is doubled while sustainable; the first unsustainable L ends a series.

background_load.note: background_busy = system busy fraction minus this process's CPU share; child processes (MATLAB, ZMQ clients, controller processes, parallel point workers) count as background
